page_title: ATA 1-1 ACM | Atalanta v AC Milan 28/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+3' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+3' The referee is firm and issues Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) a deserved yellow card.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A cross from a corner kick by Atalanta is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) will replace Alexis Saelemaekers.
89' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
87' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the top right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Mike Maignan.
85' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
83' Isak Hien (Atalanta) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
82' Ivan Juric has decided to make a change. Lazar Samardzic replaces Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Yunus Musah (Atalanta) is replacing Mario Pasalic.
81' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
77' This is a yellow card! Luka Modric (AC Milan) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
76' Atalanta are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
72' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Honest Ahanor and he is replaced by Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch so that Lorenzo Bernasconi can be given a rest.
70' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.
66' Isak Hien (Atalanta) brings an opponent down and Daniele Doveri interrupts the game.
62' Problems for Massimiliano Allegri as Santiago Tomas Gimenez is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) replaces him.
60' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
59' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
59' Isak Hien (Atalanta) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
58' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
57' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
56' Some neat passing and movement from Atalanta as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
53' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
51' The Atalanta players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
50' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
48' A pass from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is intercepted by Mike Maignan and the move breaks down.
48' Atalanta hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
47' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) attempts an acrobatic volley on the edge of the box, but it's a wild effort and flies high over the bar.
46' AC Milan keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
46' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) comes on the pitch for Rafael Leao.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Doveri starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) but poses no threat.
45+1' Atalanta string together a series of short passes.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Atalanta fail to score from a corner as Mike Maignan (AC Milan) leaps to collect the ball.
43' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
40' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
39' The game is interrupted now, Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

35' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Mario Pasalic slips the ball through to Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:1.
33' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniele Doveri signals.
30' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
25' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
23' A cross by Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
21' Ederson (Atalanta) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mike Maignan.
20' Ivan Juric is forced to make a change. Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is unable to continue due to injury, Marco Brescianini comes on.
18' The corner kick from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
17' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' Neat passing move from AC Milan in order to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
12' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
8' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
7' A dangerous towering header by Isak Hien (Atalanta) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
6' The linesman points to the corner flag, Atalanta are going to take it.
5' The Atalanta players are exchanging some short passes.

4' 0 - 1 Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1 with this magnificent strike.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
3' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
3' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
3' A player from Atalanta brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
2' The ball is cleared after Luka Modric (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' Great teamplay by AC Milan as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
AC Milan will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will supervise the game today.
